About Pratt Miller, An Oshkosh Company
Pratt Miller is a product development company in motorsports, defense, and mobility industries providing clients with product engineering and low-volume production solutions. Our range of research & development, engineering, prototype manufacturing, test & validation, and low-rate production capability help our customers bring their high-quality products to market faster.
The Modeling and Simulation Engineering Intern will support engineering activities related to multibody dynamics, vehicle dynamics, durability, and/or multi-physics simulation. The intern will work with experienced engineers to build, run, post-process, and evaluate simulation models used for product development.

Assist with multibody dynamics modeling, vehicle performance analysis, and co-simulation activities.

Support comparison and correlation of simulation results with physical test data.
Assist with development of scripts and tools for simulation setup, data processing, visualization, and reporting.
Work with engineering teams such as design, test, controls, and manufacturing to support project activities.
Document model assumptions, analysis methods, results, and conclusions.
Participate in technical discussions, design reviews, and team meetings.

Excellent time management and organizational skills.

Dependable attendance and accountability for assigned tasks.
Commitment to quality, safety, and continuous improvement.

Previous internship, Formula SAE/Baja SAE, research, laboratory, design-team, or engineering project experience is beneficial but not required.

Strong analytical thinking, curiosity, and problem-solving skills.
Ability to work independently on well-defined tasks while seeking guidance when needed.

reason: Stack +7; Title fit +6; US +10
description_preview:
Roles & Responsibilities
We are seeking a highly collaborative Digital Process Engineer to support enterprise digital transformation initiatives focused on manufacturing, process engineering, and operational data optimization within a regulated environment.
This role will combine process engineering knowledge with advanced digital and data capabilities to help modernize how process data is captured, analyzed, visualized, and leveraged across the organization.
The ideal candidate will be digitally fluent with experience supporting generative AI initiatives, FAIR data principles, data contextualization, and intelligent document authoring solutions designed to streamline and revolutionize technical documentation workflows.
This individual will play a key role in transforming manufacturing and process data into scalable digital solutions that improve operational efficiency, decision-making, and knowledge management.
The engineer will work cross-functionally with Quality, Automation, Global Engineering, Manufacturing, Equipment, and Systems Infrastructure teams to support digital integration and data-driven initiatives.
Responsibilities include supporting historian and operational data systems, data manipulation and transformation activities, development of scalable data models and dashboards, and integration of platforms such as Databricks and Grafana to enable advanced analytics and visualization capabilities.
Approximately 35% of the role will require strong process engineering and manufacturing understanding, while the remaining focus will center on digital enablement, data strategy, and AI-driven process improvements.
Candidates should possess excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to operate effectively across both technical and business-facing teams in a fast-paced transformation environment.

Our Corporate headquarters are in Dublin, CA, we have 3 buying offices in key markets in New York City, Los Angeles, and Boston, and 8 distribution centers nationwide. With 2023 revenues of $20.4 billion, we are a Fortune 500 company who is committed to providing an inclusive work environment with continuous learning opportunities and development for our teams.
GENERAL PURPOSE
The Engineer II role focuses on designing, developing, and supporting modern full-stack applications using Angular for responsive user interfaces and Spring Boot for scalable, high-performing backend services. This role is responsible for building and enhancing web-based solutions that support complex business processes, developing RESTful APIs and microservices, and ensuring seamless integration between frontend and backend systems. The Engineer II implements reusable components, follows established architectural patterns and development standards, and collaborates closely with product owners, architects, and fellow engineers to deliver high-quality software. The role also supports application maintenance, troubleshooting, performance optimization, and continuous improvement to ensure reliability, scalability, and a positive user experience.
Essential Functions
Design, develop, test, and maintain full-stack applications using Angular for responsive user interfaces and Spring Boot for scalable, high-performing APIs and microservices.
Build and enhance Azure cloud-native and on-premises applications, ensuring solutions are scalable, reliable, secure, and aligned with established architectural standards.
Develop reusable frontend components and backend services using modular design principles, supporting maintainability, consistency, and efficient delivery.
Collaborate with product owners, UX designers, architects, and engineering teams to deliver end-to-end solutions that meet business and technical requirements.
Translate UX designs, wireframes, and prototypes into high-quality user experiences using tools such as Figma, ensuring seamless integration with backend APIs and data models.
Leverage AI-assisted development tools, including GitHub Copilot and MCP-based integrations, to improve developer productivity, accelerate delivery, and maintain code quality.
Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines and automated testing processes using tools such as GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, and Jenkins to support reliable software releases.
Apply secure coding practices, accessibility standards, responsive design principles, API best practices, and coding standards throughout the software development lifecycle.
Troubleshoot, support, and enhance applications in production environments, ensuring high levels of performance, reliability, and user satisfaction.
Develop solutions that support complex retail business processes and customer-facing experiences, partnering with stakeholders to deliver business-aligned outcomes.
Assist in the development and integration of AI-powered features and services into custom applications, collaborating with architects and engineering teams to deliver intelligent, business-focused user experiences.

Listening

7+ years of experience in software engineering with hands-on full-stack application development experience across frontend and backend technologies.
Strong proficiency in Angular and Spring Boot, with experience developing enterprise web applications, RESTful APIs, microservices, and distributed systems.
Experience developing cloud-native and hybrid applications, preferably using Microsoft Azure technologies and services.
Solid understanding of modern application architecture principles, including component-based UI development, event-driven architectures, system integration, scalability, performance, and reliability.
Experience with UI/UX implementation and collaboration tools such as Figma, with the ability to translate designs into intuitive, responsive, and accessible user experiences.

Experience leveraging AI-assisted development tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, MCP-based tooling, or similar technologies) to improve developer productivity and code quality.

Preferred

At Aurora, you will tackle massively complex problems alongside other passionate, intelligent individuals, growing as an expert while expanding your knowledge. For the latest news from Aurora, visit aurora.tech or follow us on LinkedIn.
What We Are Looking For
Aurora hires talented people with diverse backgrounds who are ready to help build a transportation ecosystem that will make our roads safer, get crucial goods where they need to go, and make mobility more efficient and accessible for all.
We're looking for a Senior Software Engineer to join our Corporate Engineering team — the team that treats Aurora's internal platform ecosystem as an engineering problem, not a ticket queue. You'll own a portfolio of SaaS platforms end-to-end: not just administering them, but understanding what each one is for, who uses it and how, how it connects to everything else, and where it should go next. Today that portfolio centers on our collaboration platforms (Google Workspace, Slack) and incident management platforms (FireHydrant, OpsGenie); over time it will change as our stack evolves — and your ability to reach deep ownership of a platform you've never touched is exactly what we're hiring for.
Support requests will cross your desk — access issues, permissions, broken workflows. Your job is not simply to work that queue; it's primarily to make categories of it disappear. You'll classify what's coming in, root-cause why it exists, and then eliminate it: automate it away, redesign the process that generates it, build self-service, or put an AI agent in the loop. If you measure your impact in classes of problems that no longer exist rather than tickets closed, this is your seat.
In this role you will
Own platforms at the architectural level. For each platform in your portfolio, be the person who can answer: what is this for, what are the use cases, how do users actually interact with it, how does identity and lifecycle flow through it, and how does it fit into Aurora's larger application ecosystem. Set the technical strategy and roadmap for the domain.
Engineer away toil. Treat recurring requests as bugs. Categorize inbound work, find the systemic cause, and eliminate it — through automation against platform APIs, workflow redesign, self-service tooling, or AI agents handling the loop. Write real software to do it (Python, TypeScript/JavaScript), in version control, with review.
Design and automate identity and lifecycle workflows — onboarding, offboarding, role changes — across the enterprise ecosystem using APIs, webhooks, SCIM, and IAM tooling (Okta, SSO) and integration platforms (e.g., Workato).
Lead platform lifecycle end-to-end as our stack evolves: assess and pilot new tools, drive phased rollouts and integrations, govern configuration, and deprecate what we outgrow. Define build-vs-buy and licensing strategy using usage data to keep SaaS spend disciplined.
Put AI to work in the enterprise. Drive adoption of Enterprise AI tooling (Claude and similar) and build agentic automation into support and business workflows — partnering with Security to do it safely.
Serve as the escalation point for the hardest problems on these platforms — with the standing goal that the same problem never needs escalating twice.

Strong software engineering fundamentals: proficiency in at least one language (Python, TypeScript/JavaScript), working in version control with code review, and owning automations or services that run in production.
A demonstrated track record of eliminating manual work at scale — you can point to categories of requests or processes you made permanently disappear, not just tasks you completed.
Deep, hands-on experience integrating SaaS platforms via APIs, webhooks, and event-driven patterns, including identity and lifecycle automation (SSO, SCIM, Okta or similar).
Proven ability to take architectural ownership of a platform you didn't previously know: rapidly building a mental model of its purpose, use cases, data flows, and integration points. We care more about this adaptability than about experience with our exact stack.
Systems thinking across an application ecosystem — you reason about how tools connect, where data and identity flow, and what the second-order effects of a change are.
